harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive-FTP dropbox for the staged scanner account. Upload/download, sample integrity, chroot confinement, anonymous denial, and recovery after sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Installed the AlmaLinux-compatible vsftpd package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured the scanner account with a non-login shell, account allowlist, and chroot to the dedicated dropbox.
Enabled passive-only FTP with TCP ports 30000-30049, firewalld rules, and SELinux write labeling.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample from node2 and verified its SHA-256 checksum.
Verified host files outside the dropbox are inaccessible and anonymous login returns FTP 530.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, proving changed boot identities and complete service/data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Passive FTP destination and confined scanner account
evidence.summary: Node1 shows vsftpd enabled and active, scanner as the sole allowlisted account, chroot rooted at the dedicated dropbox, passive ports 30000-30049, active mode disabled, anonymous disabled, and persistent firewall/SELinux configuration.

evidence.requirement: Upload and retrieval, including supplied sample
evidence.summary: Node2 uploaded sample-scan.txt using passive FTP, retrieved it with an identical SHA-256, retrieved received.txt, and repeated upload/retrieval successfully after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Host files inaccessible and anonymous access unavailable
evidence.summary: Traversal outside the chroot failed, while anonymous authentication was denied with FTP 530 both before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes began on AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6; node1 retained that release and kernel in the final audit.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and changed boot ID 02c847a1-32f2-491b-b716-6c7364226fad observed. Service, listener, files, hashes, and remote retrieval recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and changed boot ID 02f437ec-1233-4d90-aa57-78bebf3dba9c observed. Staged data, passive upload/retrieval, confinement, and anonymous denial all recovered.

attempts.summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive-FTP dropbox for the staged scanner account. Upload/download, sample integrity, chroot confinement, anonymous denial, and recovery after sequential node restarts were verified.
